title: technology is STRANGER than it looks 💾 | part 11
description: The first computer mouse was wooden. Part 12 tomorrow.
hook: Technology is stranger than it looks.
facts: The first computer mouse was made of wood.
Your phone has more computing power than the rockets that went to the Moon.
The first alarm clock could only ring at four in the morning.
The keyboard layout you use was designed for old typewriters. Not for speed.
The save icon is a floppy disk. Most kids have never seen one.
outro: Follow for part twelve. It gets stranger.
